14988.commentary: (SNPa) udare yato'ti udare yato saṃyato mitabhojī, āhāre mattaññū'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (THa) kathaṃ pana siyā'ti āha ūn'ūdaro mit'āhāro'ti paṇītaṃ lūkhaṃ vā'pi bhojanaṃ bhuñjanto bhikkhu yāva'd'atthaṃ abhuñjitvā ūn'ūdaro sallahukudaro, tato eva mit'āhāro parimitabhojano aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgataṃ āhāraṃ āharanto tattha mattaññutāya paccavekkhaṇasatiyā ca sato hutvā paribbaje vihareyya.

examples.text: kāyagutto vacīgutto, āhāre udare yato, saccaṃ karomi niddānaṃ, soraccaṃ me pamocanaṃ.
ūn'ūdaro mit'āhāro, app'icchassa alolupo, sadā icchāya nicchāto, aniccho hoti nibbuto.
dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, visado'va nikkhamati amakkhito udarena amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho visado.

14992.meaning1: skin of the stomach; belly skin

14994.commentary: (SNPa) udarassa pūro udarapūro. udaran'ti ca udariyass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tañ'hi ṭhānanāmena udaran'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: antapūro udarapūro, yakanapeḷassa vatthino, hadayassa papphāsassa, vakkassa pihakassa ca.

14995.meaning1: stomach bulge; bump of the belly; tummy roll

14996.meaning2: filling the stomach to the utmost

14997.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of udarāvadehaka
14997.commentary: (MNa) udar'āvadehakan'ti udarapūraṃ. tañ'hi udaraṃ avadehanato udar'āvadehakan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yāva'd'atthaṃ udar'āvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharati, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
udar'āvadehakaṃ bhutvā, sayant'uttānaseyyakā, kathaṃ vattenti paṭibuddhā, yā kathā satthugarahitā.

14998.commentary: (KHPa) tato paraṃ antosarīre udariyaṃ vaṇṇato ajjhohaṭ'āhāravaṇṇan'ti vavatthapeti. saṇṭhānato parissāvane sithilabaddhataṇḍula-saṇṭhānaṃ. disato uparimāya disāya jātaṃ. okāsato udare ṭhitan'ti. (ADha) udariyan'ti udare bhavaṃ asitapitakhāyitasāyitaṃ. taṃ vaṇṇato ajjhohaṭ'āhāravaṇṇaṃ. saṇṭhānato parissāvane sithilabandhataṇḍula-saṇṭhānaṃ. disato uparimāya disāya jātaṃ.

examples.text: atthi imasmiṃ kāye… antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ (matthaluṅgaṃ), pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo, assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttan'ti.
